pages.title: Our Story
pages.body:
A well-stocked pantry. An unhurried meal. One more chair around the table.

Good food starts with simple things.

Kindred Grove brings a Mediterranean way of eating into the everyday: a generous pour of olive oil, something sweet to share, and ingredients that earn their place on the shelf.

We believe the best meals do not need to be complicated. A few thoughtful staples can turn a quiet breakfast, a quick lunch or a gathering of friends into something worth remembering.

A considered pantry.

Start with the essentials. Choose what you love to cook with, and make it part of your everyday.

Small rituals.

Finish a dish with olive oil. Set out dates with coffee. Make a little time for the good things.

Good company.

Food is a reason to gather. Leave room at the table and pass something delicious around.

From our pantry to your table.

Explore our olive oil and Medjool dates, then visit our recipes for a few simple ways to enjoy them. Product details, sizes and availability are listed on each product page.

pages.title: Recipes
pages.body:
Everyday ingredients. A little inspiration. Something good on the table.

Three simple recipes to come back to. Adjust the seasoning to your taste, and check ingredient labels for allergens before cooking.

Tomato & olive oil toast · Tahini-stuffed dates · Lemon & olive oil dressing

THE SLOW BREAKFAST

Tomato & olive oil toast

Serves 2 · About 10 minutes

What you need

  • 2 thick slices of bread
  • 2 ripe tomatoes
  • 2 tablespoons olive oil
  • A pinch of salt
  • Basil or parsley, to finish

Make it

  1. Toast the bread until crisp at the edges.
  2. Grate the tomatoes into a bowl, discarding the skin. Stir in a pinch of salt and half the olive oil.
  3. Spoon the tomatoes over the toast. Finish with the remaining oil and a few torn herbs. Serve straight away.

SOMETHING TO SHARE

Tahini-stuffed dates

Makes 8 · About 10 minutes · Contains sesame

What you need

  • 8 Medjool dates
  • 2 tablespoons tahini
  • 1 tablespoon toasted sesame seeds
  • A small pinch of flaky salt

Make it

  1. Cut a slit along each date and carefully remove the stone.
  2. Fill each date with a little tahini.
  3. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and a few flakes of salt. Arrange on a small plate and share with coffee or tea.

THE EVERYDAY FINISH

Lemon & olive oil dressing

Serves 4 · About 5 minutes

What you need

  • 3 tablespoons olive oil
  • 1 tablespoon lemon juice
  • 1 small garlic clove, finely grated
  • Salt and black pepper, to taste

Make it

  1. Whisk the lemon juice and garlic in a small bowl.
  2. Slowly whisk in the olive oil until combined.
  3. Season to taste. Spoon over salad leaves, cooked beans or warm vegetables just before serving.

pages.title: FAQ
pages.body:
A few things you might like to know.

Where can I find product ingredients and sizes?

Visit the individual product page for its description, pack size, price and current availability. If you need more information before ordering, use our Contact page.

How should I store olive oil?

Keep the bottle tightly closed, away from direct sunlight and heat. Follow any storage guidance on the product label.

How should I store dates?

Follow the storage instructions on the packaging. Keep dates sealed between servings, and check the label for refrigeration guidance.

Can you help with an allergy or dietary question?

Read the product label and ingredient information before using any food. Contact us if a detail is missing; do not assume a product is suitable for a particular allergy or diet.

Where do I see shipping options?

Available destinations and delivery charges appear at checkout after you enter your address. Our Shipping & Returns page explains where to find the relevant information.

Can I change an order?

Contact us with your order number and the change you would like to make. Availability depends on whether the order has already been processed.

Do you accept wholesale enquiries?

Use our Wholesale page to tell us about your business and what you are looking for. Sending an enquiry does not place an order.

The details that help you order with confidence.

Delivery options

Delivery estimates

Use the estimate shown for the delivery option you choose. If no estimate is displayed, contact us before ordering rather than assuming a delivery date.

Returns and order problems

If something arrives damaged, is incorrect or needs attention, contact us with your order number and a description of the issue. Eligibility for returns and refunds depends on the product, the published refund policy and applicable consumer rights.

For a return request, please contact us before sending anything back. This page does not limit any statutory rights you may have.

Before you order

Check product information and the policies linked in the footer, and ask us about any detail that is unclear.
